title: 5 Fastest Cars On Earth — Number 1 Is Terrifying
narration:
These mind-blowing hypercars push human engineering to the absolute limit. You will not believe how fast they run. But number one goes so ridiculously fast, it feels almost terrifying...

Starting off at number five... we have the Rimac Nevera! This all-electric monster packs four motors that unleash nearly two thousand horsepower. It shoots from zero to sixty miles per hour in under two seconds... That makes it faster off the line than a modern Formula One race car!

Coming in at number four... it is the insane Hennessey Venom F5! Built in Texas, this terrifying machine houses a twin-turbo engine with over eighteen hundred horsepower. It is built out of carbon fiber and was engineered specifically to crush three hundred miles per hour...

Sliding into the number three spot... the sleek SSC Tuatara! This aerodynamic masterpiece weighs less than a tiny compact car while generating incredible speed. It reached proven test speeds of nearly three hundred miles per hour... Its smooth body cuts through the air like a razor blade.

At number two... the world-famous Bugatti Chiron Super Sport! This four-million-dollar land rocket became the first official road car to break three hundred miles per hour. It burns through an entire tank of gasoline in under ten minutes when pushing at its absolute top speed...

And finally... sitting at number one... the utterly terrifying Koenigsegg Jesko Absolut! This Swedish speed demon is computer-designed to soar past three hundred and ten miles per hour... It features long rear fins inspired by fighter jets to maintain stability. Nothing on four wheels matches this level of pure speed!

Which of these crazy hypercars would you dare to drive at top speed? Drop your ranking in the comments below!

title: 5 Tallest Skyscrapers On Earth — Number 1 Is Terrifying 🏙️
narration: Imagine standing above the clouds where a simple breeze can make a massive skyscraper sway like a tree. Number one on this list is so insanely tall that you can watch the sunset twice in one single evening... Starting at number five, we have... Lotte World Tower in Seoul, South Korea. Rising over five hundred and fifty meters into the sky, this massive glass giant features a sky deck with a glass floor that makes visitors feel like they are floating. Coming in at number four, it is... Ping An Center in Shenzhen, China. Reaching almost six hundred meters tall, this sleek mega-structure handles brutal typhoon winds using a clever tapered shape and heavy steel pillars. At number three, we find... Makkah Clock Tower in Mecca, Saudi Arabia. Standing over six hundred meters high, this giant complex holds the largest clock face on the planet, visible from over thirty kilometers away. Taking the number two spot, it is... Shanghai Tower in China. Soaring nearly six hundred and thirty meters high, its incredible twisting outer glass shell reduces wind forces while housing ultra-fast glass elevators. Finally, at number one... Burj Khalifa in Dubai. Pushing past a mind-blowing eight hundred meters tall, this terrifying behemoth is so tall its top is noticeably cooler than the street, and it dominates the desert skyline. Which of these terrifying megastructures would you dare visit? Comment your ranking below!

title: 5 Largest Cat Breeds — Number 1 Is Terrifying 🐾
narration: These massive domestic cats look like wild jungle predators, but wait until you see number 1, because it grows longer than a baseball bat! Starting at number 5, the Norwegian Forest Cat... This ancient mountain giant weighs over 20 pounds, stands almost 12 inches tall, and wears a thick waterproof fur coat built to survive freezing Arctic blizzards. At number 4, the Siberian Cat... Weighing nearly 25 pounds, this muscular beast has a triple layer coat and possesses incredible back legs that launch it over 6 feet into the air. Coming in at number 3, the Ragdoll... This gorgeous blue-eyed giant reaches over 20 pounds and grows more than 3 feet long, famously collapsing completely relaxed in your arms like a giant plush doll. Stepping up to number 2, the Savannah Cat... Born from wild servals, this tall feline stands nearly 20 inches high, weighs up to 25 pounds, and easily clears an 8 foot fence in one single leap. And at number 1, the legendary Maine Coon... This gentle giant weighs over 25 pounds and stretches more than 4 feet long from nose to tail, making it look like a fully grown mountain lion living in your house! Which giant cat would you pick as your pet, comment your top ranking down below!

title: 5 Biggest Sharks In History — Number 1 Is Terrifying 🦈
narration: The ocean has produced some truly massive ocean monsters throughout earth history, but the largest oceanic killer was bigger than a city bus. Here are the five biggest sharks that ever lived... Starting at number 5, we have... Cretoxyrhina. Known as the Ginsu shark, this ancient ocean killer swam ninety million years ago. It grew over seven meters long and easily sliced through heavy turtle armor. At number 4, it is the... Basking Shark. This living giant reaches lengths of over ten meters today. It cruises open oceans with a giant mouth to feed on tiny plankton. Coming in at number 3, we find... Otodus Chubutensis. This prehistoric terror reached nearly thirteen meters long. It was an ancient relative of Megalodon that hunted massive whales in deep waters. Moving to number 2, it is the... Whale Shark. Reaching up to eighteen meters long, this is the largest living shark on Earth. Its giant mouth filters thousands of gallons of water every hour. Finally, at number 1, the supreme ruler is... Megalodon. This nightmare predator grew to twenty meters long and weighed over fifty tons. Its massive jaws could easily crush an entire killer whale. Which of these gigantic ocean monsters would you least want to swim with in the wild?
